meta.name: holdbc1-hard1 stand/sit (HOLD+RISE 10M)
meta.notes: Overnight 08-11 HOLD+RISE+LOWER specialist: 10M hardening with a BC anchor on a recorded belly-to-plant rise and a feet-planted income gate. Sim: quiet six-foot hold 11/12, clean sit, crouch-start rise still tips 2/4; trained with the loaded servo model but NOT the full deployment contract, zero hardware runs yet. Implication: sit and hold should be a visible upgrade; RL stand-up is the experiment — supervise with a hand ready, tuck remains the known-good fallback.
